name: Rullst
workers: Tokio multi-threaded runtime, one worker per available CPU (2)
database_layer: rullst-orm (#[derive(Orm)] with RowSnapshot: find, save, all, query builder; SQLx PostgreSQL pool)

phase2.validation: ValidatedJson and ValidatedForm (#[derive(Validate)]: constraint failures 422, unreadable bodies 400); GET /worlds: Query (400) and FieldErrors::validate (422); Path<i32> (400)

csrf.mechanism: csrf_middleware on /form and /login only: double-submit rullst_csrf cookie, token masked per response in the _token field, compared in constant time; 403

session.mechanism: session registry as cargo rullst auth generates it: rullst_session cookie sealed with APP_KEY, one rullst_auth_sessions row per sign-in, read by primary key on every request

notes: Rullst router, ORM and html! without the Server middleware stack; comparable to the Axum app.
role_note: Rullst's router, ORM and html! served without the production middleware that cargo rullst new generates, comparable to the Axum app. It is not how Rullst sets up an application, so it is a diagnostic shown next to the reference, with scores and without a position; Rullst as generated is the ranked Rullst.
